text:
Convenient location near BTS On Nut, less than 100 meters away. Clean restrooms.
You can schedule appointments online in advance. No waiting upon arrival; appointments are scheduled on time.

The person in charge of coordination and management provided excellent and detailed information. I inquired about social security benefits and was informed that they could be used (ID card required). Regarding treatment costs, a clear list of treatments and prices was provided. The prices are standard, but considering the convenience of the location, the time saved from scheduling in advance, and the service and treatment itself, it was more than worth it.

I was treated by Dr. Lertlak Ruangsinpinya. Upon entering the examination room, the doctor asked about my symptoms and explained the possible causes. Then, the doctor began examining my teeth, offering me a mirror to view my teeth while she examined them, so I could understand what was happening. After a (detailed) examination, the doctor mentioned a small cavity and offered three options: 1. X-ray for a more detailed examination of any problems. 2. Filling (optional, as the cavity was small, but prompt filling was recommended). 3. Scaling (tartar removal). The cost of each item was also explained. I opted for all three treatments. It started with an X-ray. When the results came back, the doctor pointed out and explained every detail, showing where the dark spots (on the film) might be and why. The doctor then thoroughly examined the problematic areas. The results showed only one cavity, exactly as the doctor had initially examined. Then they began filling the tooth and scaling. During the treatment, these are some of the things I remember hearing: "Close your mouth, rest your mouth," the doctor knew my mouth was tired (lol), "Raise your left hand if it hurts," "I need to go a little deeper here," "Relax your mouth," "Turn to the right, bend down a little," "Adjust the chair." Everything I've written here is to convey that the doctor communicated with the patient exceptionally well, clearly, professionally, and always considered the patient's needs. I knew in advance what would happen during the treatment. Other doctors I've been treated by elsewhere were also very good, but Dr. Lertlak was exceptional. She paid attention to every detail (lol), and it created understanding and peace of mind as a patient.

The doctor's assistant was also very helpful in answering questions and highly skilled. The doctor communicated with the patient throughout the treatment, but the assistant hardly needed to be told what to do. Then, during the post-scaling irrigation, the assistant suctioned the water very well. I didn't feel like my mouth was flooded with water at all.

While writing this, I also saw reviews about other doctors here. They all provide excellent treatment. I recommend you try it!

For foreigners reading this review, you should definitely visit this clinic. I couldn’t recommend it more. The service and treatment are excellent. The price is standard—actually even cheap compared to what you receive. You can check the prices before deciding, as they clearly list all prices and keep them fair.
